title: NIC 2026 Azure Local environment (environment/azure-local/*.yml)
description: Landing-zone variables (design/azure-local/landing-zone.md section 10.6), cluster facts (nodes, VLANs, intents, IP plan, QoS, witness, identity, release from design/azure-local/network-design.md) and vault names. Secrets are keyvault:// references only. Unknown keys are rejected.

arc_machine_names.description: Node host name -> Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines name, when they differ. Simplified machine provisioning names the Arc machine <device-id>-1 (edgeMachines/<node> properties.arcMachineResourceId). Kept out of nodes[] so device automation never carries Azure IDs. Missing node = host name.

node_preparation.description: Node preparation before cluster Validate (os-provisioning Initialize-ProvisionedNode.ps1 and Initialize-OemNode.ps1): OEM drivers that replace inbox drivers (Learn: inbox drivers are not supported) and the data disks ClearDisks may clear.

sbe_bundle.description: Local path of the approved OEM Solution Builder Extension bundle: the zip, or the folder it unpacks to (SBE_*.xml manifest with per-file SHA-256 + SBE_*.zip payload). Drivers with sbe_path are extracted from it and verified against that manifest (never committed).

hardware_id.description: PnP hardware ID prefix the driver must bind to, e.g. PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_159B

sbe_path.description: Folder of the driver inside the SBE payload, e.g. DriversGE\Network\Intel\E810\3VT4C; hashes come from the SBE manifest.

source_path.description: Alternative to sbe_path: local folder with the approved, unmodified driver package (never committed).

sha256.description: With source_path: file name -> expected SHA-256 (from the OEM SWBOM).

data_disks.description: ClearDisks stage (both routes, before Validate): which disks of each node are the Storage Spaces Direct data disks. The boot/system disk is excluded by IsBoot/IsSystem AND boot_model_pattern; only disks of bus_type whose model matches model_pattern are cleared, and their number must equal count, otherwise the stage refuses.

bus_type.description: Get-PhysicalDisk BusType of the data disks.

model_pattern.description: Wildcard patterns (-like) matched against Get-PhysicalDisk Model or FriendlyName of the data disks.

boot_model_pattern.description: Wildcard patterns of the boot device model; the IsBoot/IsSystem disk must match one, and any disk that matches is never touched.

tags.description: Optional scope tag overrides merged with shared tags, including the workload tag from naming standard 3a.

subscription_id.description: Azure Local landing-zone subscription (same value as shared.subscriptions.azure_local).

avd_spoke_vnet_id.description: AVD spoke VNet id for a direct peering from the Azure Local landing zone. Leave empty: lz-avd owns both sides of that peering; a second one would fail.

avd_spoke_prefix.description: AVD spoke address prefix for NSG rules (same value as avd.avd_vnet_prefix).

enable_identity_peering.description: lz-azure-local: create the direct spoke<->identity VNet peerings (one resource on the shared identity VNet; owner approval, P-13).

enable_management_peering.description: lz-azure-local: create the direct spoke<->management VNet peerings (owner approval, P-13).

manage_pim_in_iac.description: lz-azure-local: create PIM eligible assignments from IaC instead of the script (default false).

jump_data_disk_gb.description: Jump server data disk size in GiB (MP-02).

jump_server_source_prefix.description: D-056: private IPv4 /32 of the jump server; lz-azure-local adds AllowJumpServerInbound (priority 101, all protocols and ports) to every NSG. Empty = no rule.

jump_private_ip.description: Static private IP of the jump server inside subnet_jump_prefix (MP-02).

jump_encryption_at_host.description: Encryption at host for the jump server (needs the Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost feature).

enabled_stages.description: lz-azure-local IaC stages to deploy in this run (subset of S1..S7).

secret_name_prefix.description: Normally inherited from shared; set here only to override for this scope.

enable_private_endpoints.description: Owner decision D-029. false (default) = public endpoints, no privatelink zones, links or private link; true = private-endpoint design.

external_jump_vm_id.description: Runtime-only explicit relocated jump; not an IaC parameter. Original workload VM/disks retained for rollback until ownership reconciliation.

external_jump_subnet_id.description: Runtime-only expected existing subnet of relocated jump; paired with external_jump_vm_id.

jump_admin_username.description: Local administrator name written to the ops vault (jump_admin_username_secret) the first time Invoke-LzAzureLocalDeploy.ps1 generates the jump credential. Not Administrator. Optional once the secret exists.

entra_groups.description: Entra group display names (naming standard section 5).

group_object_ids.description: Object IDs written by the group-creation script (S0), keyed by the lz-azure-local names-catalog keys.

central_log_analytics_workspace_id.description: Resource ID of the central Log Analytics workspace of the platform management subscription; empty creates a workload workspace.

deploy_platform_scope_items.description: Deploy subscription policy and Defender, the activity-log export and peerings on platform-owned VNets; false (default) leaves them to their owners.

kv_public_network_access.description: Per-vault phase flag (K-4): the cluster vault stays Enabled through Validate/Deploy.

azl_rp_app_object_id.description: Object id of the Microsoft.AzureStackHCI Resource Provider first-party application in this tenant.

create_workspace.description: cluster-configure/monitoring: create the Log Analytics workspace names.law (D-054).

manage_insights_dcr_in_iac.description: cluster-configure/monitoring: author the Insights DCR in IaC in the dialog's shape (D-054).

insights_extra_event_channels.description: Extra XPath channels in the Insights DCR.

observability_agent.description: Azure Copilot Observability Agent prerequisites (D-047): Azure Monitor workspace, Issue Contributor principals, subscriptions to associate.

maintenance_window.description: cluster-configure/update-manager: maintenance window (start 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', duration 'HH:mm', Windows time zone, recurrence).

backup_azure_vms.description: cluster-configure/backup-asr: Azure VMs protected with the Azure VM backup policy.

asr.description: cluster-configure/backup-asr: Hyper-V-to-Azure Site Recovery of Azure Local VMs (T-5.5.3): scripted Prepare infrastructure, replication and test failover.

node_vault_role.description: Built-in role granted to each node's Arc identity on the vault (default Site Recovery Contributor).

os_type.description: Used when the protectable item reports no operating system.

remoting_credential_base.description: Ops-vault secret base (<base>-username/-password) the demo scripts use for PowerShell remoting to a Local Identity cluster; empty = the operator session

log_analytics_workspace_id.description: Landing-zone output recorded for the deploy and Day-2 solutions.

model.description: D-008: Local Identity with Key Vault.

dns_zone.description: DNS zone hosted on the existing DCs for nodes and cluster name.

automation_identity.description: Identity the scripts sign in with for Arc registration, cluster deploy and os-provisioning (landing-zone README, Automation identity). Roles: automation/landing-zones/azure-local/automation-identity-roles.json.

managed_identity_name.description: User-assigned identity in the security resource group; default identity.deployment_identity_name.

managed_identity_client_id_secret.description: Client ID of the user-assigned identity (Connect-AzAccount -Identity -AccountId); optional when it is the only identity on the jump server.

service_principal_object_id.description: Enterprise application object ID; needed by the landing zone to grant the roles.

grant_roles.description: Landing-zone S3 grants the roles of automation-identity-roles.json.

simplified_provisioning.description: Also grant the os-provisioning roles (Contributor and constrained Role Based Access Control Administrator).

storage_key_secret.description: Platform-mandated WitnessStorageKey in the cluster vault (written by the deploy script, never by IaC).

adapter_names.description: Physical port -> network adapter name as the node OS reports it. The name depends on how the OS was installed (simplified provisioning: Port1..Port6; OEM image: 'Embedded NIC 1', 'SLOT 3 Port 1', ...). intents[].adapters reference these values (YAML anchors), so a route change edits this map only.

rdma_protocol.description: Storage intent: required (Validate rejects RDMA without a protocol). Must match the adapters' *NetworkDirectTechnology mode.

infrastructure_pool.description: Contiguous management-pool addresses (>= 6); the cluster IP is the first.

reserved_ranges.description: Must stay unused anywhere the nodes can reach (Arc Resource Bridge).

sdn.description: SDN enabled by Azure Arc (network-design 4.6, D-048).

vm_management.description: Where Azure Local VM resources (images, NICs, disks, VMs) are created: cluster resource group and custom location.

vm_images.description: Azure Local VM images (storage-design.md section 6). source marketplace: publisher/offer/sku/version.

workload_vms.description: Workload VMs seeded on the cluster (the app and data tiers of the demo estate).

local_admin_username.description: User name written to the vault when the username secret does not exist yet (New-WorkloadVm.ps1 -CreateMissingSecret). Optional.

workload_tag.description: Value of the workload tag on the VMs, NICs and disks. Optional; default is the shared tags workload value, else azure-local.

security_type.description: Default TrustedLaunch. Standard (no Trusted launch, secure boot and vTPM off) for a VM replicated by Azure Site Recovery (Hyper-V-to-Azure DR supports neither).

purpose.description: Optional purpose tag merged on the VM, NIC and disks (for example asr-demo).

demo_vm_lifecycle.description: Azure Local outline 4.4 VM lifecycle through Arc (resource inventory A10, storage-design.md section 5): the VM automation/demo/azure-local/scripts/Invoke-ArcVmLifecycleDemo.ps1 creates, inspects and deletes (-Stage Create | Show | Remove; -Target Live | Rehearsal). No static IP and no NIC NSG: the NIC takes a pool address and the logical network's NSG applies. Local administrator comes from workload_vms.local_admin_*_secret.

name.description: Live target: created and deleted on stage.

rehearsal_vm.description: Rehearsal target, kept running for the inspect step; -Target Rehearsal builds it.

rehearsal_purpose_tag.description: purpose tag merged on the rehearsal VM, NIC and disks.

logical_network.description: Must be one of logical_networks[].name (the script reads its NSG and pool from there).

security_type.description: The script always enables secure boot and vTPM, so only Trusted launch is consistent.

workload_tag.description: Value of the workload tag on the VM, NIC and disks.

sofs_cluster.description: SOFS guest cluster for FSLogix (storage-design.md section 4, D-050; T-5.5.4).

solution_update.description: Solution update with additional content (OEM SBE) imported from a local package (Learn: Update Azure Local via PowerShell). Used by cluster-configure/update-manager/scripts/Invoke-SolutionUpdate.ps1.

package_folder.description: Folder on the machine that runs the script with the SBE discovery xml, inventory xml and payload zip.

gpu.description: GPU on the cluster nodes (design/azure-local/gpu-design.md): DDA host prep, guest driver, GPU VMs. Used by cluster-configure/gpu.

secret_refs.description: Named keyvault:// references read at run time (names only; values never enter files).

hybrid_identity.description: Hybrid identity for the SOFS/FSLogix example (D-050): AD objects and the Entra Connect Sync server (never on a domain controller).

cloud_sync.description: Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync on the sync server (D-050): cloud-only Hybrid Identity Administrator account, custom gMSA, provisioning agent, Graph configuration scoped to OU=<ou_root> with password hash sync. Read by Set-HybridIdentitySync.ps1.

cloud_account_upn.description: Cloud-only member account (not a guest) used to register the agent.

cloud_account_username_secret.description: Ops vault secret name holding the UPN.

cloud_account_password_secret.description: Ops vault secret name holding the password (generated when missing, never printed).

hybrid_identity_admin_role_id.description: Built-in Hybrid Identity Administrator role template ID.

gmsa_name.description: Custom gMSA name without the trailing $ (15 characters max).

agent_version.description: Agent version last installed (reported, not pinned).

application_template_id.description: AD2AAD application template (Learn: configure cloud sync with MS Graph).

configuration_name.description: Display name of the AD2AAD service principal (the AD domain name by convention).

pim_assignments.description: Eligible PIM rows (group key from entra_groups, built-in role name) at subscription scope. Optional; the access-pim solution default applies when absent.

asr_policy.description: Site Recovery replication policy tuning. Optional; solution defaults apply to every key left out.

backup_policy.description: Azure VM backup policy tuning for the Azure Local VMs (schedule in UTC HH:mm). Optional; solution defaults apply to every key left out.

alert_evaluation_frequency.description: How often the monitoring alert rules run (ISO 8601 duration, for example PT5M). Optional.

alert_window_size.description: Time window each alert rule evaluates (ISO 8601 duration, for example PT15M). Optional.

node_heartbeat_minutes.description: Minutes without a node heartbeat before the alert fires. Optional.

enable_vm_insights_dcr.description: Create the VM insights data collection rule. Optional.

vm_switch_name.description: Hyper-V switch the compute intent created (Get-VMSwitch on a node); used by the platform logical networks. Optional; the platform solution default applies when absent.

marketplace_images.description: Marketplace images to download as Azure Local VM images. Optional; the platform solution default (Windows 11 multi-session and Windows Server) applies when absent.

enable_network_security_group.description: Create the Azure Local NSG of the platform solution. Optional.

networking_type.description: Cluster network topology of the deployment. Optional.

networking_pattern.description: Recorded network pattern of the deployment (the resource derives it from the intents). Optional.

rdma_protocol.description: RDMA protocol of the storage intent; empty lets the platform decide. Optional.

sbe.description: Solution Builder Extension of the release. Optional.

security_settings.description: Security baseline switches of the deployment. Optional; every key left out stays at the secure default (true).

observability.description: Telemetry switches of the deployment. Optional.

storage_configuration_mode.description: Storage configuration of the deployment. Optional.

logs_retention_days.description: Retention of the deployment logs in days. Optional.

assign_hci_rp_role.description: Assign the Azure Stack HCI resource provider role during the deployment. Optional.

local_admin_secret_name.description: Name of the cluster Key Vault secret that holds the local administrator credential (base64 user:password). Empty or absent: <cluster_name>-LocalAdminCredential.

witness_key_secret_name.description: Name of the cluster Key Vault secret that holds the witness storage account key (base64). Empty or absent: <cluster_name>-WitnessStorageKey.

screen_hidden_terms.description: Extra literal terms the demo screen-hygiene filter masks (tenant short name, shared resource names). Optional.
